### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Opening (script): "I need to withdraw as much as I can from our Paloma Business balance today, to our usual bank account — can you tell me how much that is and help me do it?" Object: his Paloma Business balance; action: one withdrawal of the maximum withdrawable amount today to the verified bank account on file; he never proposes a figure. Identity on request: phone 3465550193, DOB 1977-11-02, ZIP 77072. Passive facts only when asked (Pro upgrade at start of month, new staff logins, card deposit Wednesday and ACH Thursday). Conditional: "If the agent explains that some charges have to be put on the account before the withdrawable amount can be worked out, you ask them to go ahead and book them". He runs the withdrawal tool himself once handed it.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse

Act now. `find_business_accounts` → `variant_name 'Paloma Business Pro'`, `status 'active'` (withdrawal allowed: balance_deposits_and_withdrawals_ceb81b96 W1), `kyb_approved_date '2023-04-05'`, `billing_cycle 'monthly'`, `current_period_start '2026-09-05'`, `current_period_end '2026-10-04'`, `plan_effective_date '2026-09-07'`, `balance_usd 23653.01`. But the withdrawable amount is not yet workable: three state-form sentences in balance_withdrawal_03bb3a55 ("When the withdrawable amount is worked out") each name a state that does not hold (see item 6). After the three charges are booked, the withdrawal is made the same day.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 (root, customer's own write) — withdraw the whole withdrawable amount; P2 — extra seat charge for users added this month; P3 — proration of the 2026-09-07 upgrade; P4 — card deposit fee on the 2026-09-23 card deposit. Direction: P1 waits on each of P2, P3, P4; no edge among P2–P4. Order: P2, P3, P4 (any order) then P1.

- Hop P1 → P2 — **state-derived**. Sentence (balance_withdrawal_03bb3a55): "The withdrawable amount is not worked out until the balance carries an extra seat fee for every user added in the past month while more users were active than the plan includes." Records: 10 `business_user_added` events 2026-09-08..09-22, 15 active users vs. 10 included; ledger has no `extra_seat_fee` entry. Write found with the sentence's words "extra seat fee … users added": mid_period_extra_seat_charges_bcf2db85 ("Users added … while more users are active than the plan includes are charged for that period at once. The agent books the extra seat charge as one extra seat fee entry"), tool `charge_extra_seats_0d292d98`; amount from extra_seat_charge_adade9e5 and its factor documents.
- Hop P1 → P3 — **state-derived**. Sentence: "The withdrawable amount is worked out only after an upgrade that took effect inside the current billing period carries its proration charge on the balance." Records: `plan_effective_date '2026-09-07'` inside 2026-09-05..10-04; no proration entry on the ledger. Write found with "upgrade … proration charge": upgrade_proration_settlement_0df5fcc4 ("the agent settles the proration of that period as one proration charge entry"), tool `settle_upgrade_proration_4280c277`.
- Hop P1 → P4 — **state-derived**. Sentence: "Before the withdrawable amount is worked out, the most recent debit-card deposit must carry its deposit fee on the balance." Records: `DEP-56638842` debit_card 12000.00 on 09-23 with no `deposit_fee` entry tied to it. Write found with "debit-card deposit … deposit fee": card_deposit_fee_charging_761ac43c ("A debit-card deposit carries a card deposit fee tied to its deposit reference, which the agent books as one deposit fee entry"), tool `charge_card_deposit_fee_e69fd8f7`.
- No document named any of these three tools, or the resolving problems, next to the sentences; the hops were reasoned from the depended-on documents and the records. The three sentences stand together in the blocked policy's own hub, each in its own words; no route, list of tools or ordering among P2–P4 is stated.
- Weight on the number: each charge lowers the balance from which the withdrawable amount is computed; P1 alone gives 23653.01 − 504.90 − 64.50 = 23083.61, which leaves the balance unable to carry 230.22 of charges the visible rules require before the amount is worked out.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what the customer asked": excluded by the three state-form sentences of balance_withdrawal_03bb3a55 against the records listed above.
- Fall-backs (35.00 / 90.02 / 300.00 / 16035.89) are definite and differ from 6.67 / 69.55 / 154.00 / 22853.39.
- Factor findability from the records' words: user added/removed events and roles ("approver"), payouts "batch_file" channel and "approved" records → seat documents; plan effective date inside the period and subscription fee entry → proration documents; "SWIFT payout fee" entries and deposits → rebate/credit; deposit method "debit_card"/"ach_credit" and amounts → card fee documents; returned payouts, submitted payouts, debits, owner's Personal Sender Account (`Paloma Enhanced`) and the period end → withdrawal documents. No computation document hinted at a variation; no factor document pointed elsewhere.
- Closest alternatives excluded: the plan for seat/ACH/card figures is Pro (plan effective 09-07; a72f57f0 E "fees … of the new plan apply"); users charged capped by active-beyond (5) not users added (10); the basis switches to one month because 14 ≥ 12; the ACH 6500.00 is not held back (41 months, 9 ACH deposits); reserve relief acts before rounding up (728a9340 "reduced by the reserve relief before it is rounded up"); seq numbers 1 (seats) and 2 (withdrawal) from the period's entries.
- Open points noted (not defects): the ledger visible through tools begins 2026-03-02, so the twelve-month ACH count is a lower bound (already ≥6); D4 counts the ACH hold in Paloma business days while withdrawable_amount counts calendar days — immaterial here because the factor holds nothing back.

Blind conclusion: unique solution — seats 6.67 (seq 1), proration 69.55, card deposit fee 154.00 on DEP-56638842, then the owner withdraws 22853.39 as withdrawal 2 of the period. All three hops state-derived; none pre-solved.
